title: Hallucinations: why they happen and how to reduce them
body:
A hallucination is when an AI model confidently states something false — a made-up statistic, a fake citation, an incorrect fact — without any signal that it's uncertain.

Ways to reduce hallucinations:

  • Ground the model in real source material — provide the actual document/data rather than relying on its memory.
  • Lower the temperature for factual tasks.
  • Ask explicitly for uncertainty — "If you're not confident about a fact, say so rather than guessing."
  • Ask for sources, then independently verify them.
  • Fact-check anything consequential — treat AI output on important facts the way you'd treat a tip from a knowledgeable but occasionally unreliable colleague.
